title: AEGIS Strict No-API / Web-UI Source Catalog
purpose: A reviewed list of public web UIs and static public files that AEGIS can query WITHOUT API keys and WITHOUT direct API calls. Web sources must be accessed through visible browser UI/form/query pages and parsed from the resulting public HTML/DOM. Static feeds are direct file downloads and are NOT query APIs. Does not guarantee permanent uptime or that every service permits automation.
strict_rules: Do not call vendor REST/GraphQL/JSON API endpoints in this catalog, even when they require no key.
Do not reverse-engineer or call undocumented browser-private endpoints. Interact only with normal visible web forms/search pages or fetch publicly published static files.
API keys/tokens are not required for entries to be considered in this catalog. Some websites may still impose account, CAPTCHA, free-use or query-depth limits; those are individually marked.
If CAPTCHA/login/paywall/ToS restrictions block a source, do not bypass them; mark unavailable/manual_only and continue with other sources.
Browser parsing is best-effort and can break when a site changes. Require source-specific smoke tests and save original result URL plus retrieval time.
Do not submit private/internal URLs, personal data, mail headers, secret files or sensitive indicators to third-party services without explicit operator confirmation.
Do not automatically submit URLs to public scanners (e.g. urlscan) or use VirusTotal web UI for programmatic report retrieval.
Static public files are separated from web-form sources; direct file download is allowed only where published openly and terms permit.
All active network checks from local CLI tools require AEGIS central scope enforcement, VERIFIED assets and explicit operator confirmation where specified.
Every source begins as candidate_not_runtime_tested until tested on benign known examples; never display enabled/healthy status based on catalog presence alone.
